title: The deployment
what: The repository's deployment and its standing rules: the service units under deploy/, the testbed declaration, the layout document that states the folders, and the personal-data rule no file may break.

title: Retention
what: The sweep that keeps format cases and sanitiser verdicts ninety days, run as the service starts and once a day after.

title: The service's watches
what: The watches the service keeps going beside its routes: the agency's road events, the summariser hook, Laya's health and the attachments count.
